purpose: Review official Iraqi cadastral and geographic-portal channels for anonymous parcel geometry with safe native identifiers.
assessment: Official Iraqi Ministry of Justice and Iraq Geographic Portal pages were reachable. They document national real-estate registration, deed/property-map procedures and a general state-land geographic service, but no anonymous As Samawah parcel feature layer, schema, CRS or geometry endpoint was exposed. No sample GeoJSON is retained.
registryAssessment: registryFound remains null. The Ministry of Justice is a national registration custodian, and IGP is a national/general portal; neither inspected page evidences a local As Samawah or Dhi Qar public parcel registry/map endpoint.

Followed the IGP catalogue's current View.aspx link anonymously (HTTP 200); the response was portal homepage/news content, not a map/API, so no endpoint was guessed.
Fetched the linked e-service application shell anonymously (HTTP 200); it requires JavaScript/authenticated workflow and exposed no safe public parcel response.

No exact WUP-point or city-extent parcel request was run because no documented anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was found. The unchanged point [31.3134839412364, 45.2807814279876] is preserved and no absence inference is made.

Safe field allowlist for any future public query: stable native parcel ID and geometry only. Owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, certificate and personal fields were neither requested nor retained.
